description: The supplied image is not a scientific figure. It is the publisher's "Check for updates" badge (the Crossref/Elsevier update stamp) rendered as a small graphic: a circular two-segment arrow ring — the left half yellow, the right half light blue/teal, with arrowheads — enclosing a solid red bookmark ribbon whose lower edge is notched into a V. Below the ring, two lines of dark grey sans-serif text read exactly "Check for updates". The whole badge sits on a light grey, faintly gradient rounded-rectangle background, typical of its placement beside an article title or DOI. There are no panels, no axes, no units, no scale bars, no legends, no data points and no specimen. It therefore carries no information about Fe–Mn–Al–C lightweight steels: no composition, no processing condition, no phase, no property and no measurement can be extracted from it. Because the group has no scientific content, the specialised reading steps for micrographs, spectra, curves, maps or tables find nothing to apply to. The absence of an extracted caption is consistent with this being front-matter apparatus rather than a numbered figure of the paper.

observations.observation: The image is the publisher 'Check for updates' (Crossref) stamp, not a scientific figure panel.
The badge consists of a circular two-tone arrow ring (yellow left segment, light blue/teal right segment) enclosing a solid red bookmark ribbon with a V-notched bottom edge.
The printed text below the ring reads exactly 'Check for updates' in dark grey sans-serif lettering.
The badge is drawn on a light grey rounded-rectangle background of the kind used as article front-matter apparatus.
The image contains no axes, no units, no scale bar, no legend, no data points and no specimen region.
No caption was extracted for this image, consistent with it being a publisher badge rather than a numbered figure.
This image provides no evidence about the composition, processing, phase constitution or properties of Fe-Mn-Al-C lightweight steels.
